# Mansfield Plumbing

> > American manufacturer of residential plumbing fixtures including high-efficiency toilets, luxury whirlpool bathtubs, and ADA-compliant bathroom products.

Mansfield Plumbing specializes in water-efficient toilet systems featuring SmartHeight, SmartFasten, and MagnaFlush technologies, alongside premium acrylic bathtubs with whirlpool, air massage, and hydrotherapy features. Products are manufactured in the USA and emphasize performance ratings like MaP scores and ADA compliance.

## Key Topics

- Summit toilet series
- SmartHeight ADA-compliant toilets
- Whirlpool and air massage bathtubs
- MicroDerm acrylic finish
- SmartFasten installation technology
- MagnaFlush flushing system
- High-efficiency toilets (1.28 GPF, 1.6 GPF)
- MaP performance ratings
- Swirl-Way Luxury Series bathtubs
- Freestanding and drop-in tubs
- Two-person whirlpool bathtubs
- Hydrotherapy features
- PuraClean antimicrobial glaze
- Made in USA manufacturing
- Residential plumbing fixtures

## High-Efficiency Toilet Systems

- [Barrett™ 1.28 Elongated ADA SmartHeight Toilet Combination](https://www.mansfieldplumbing.com/product/barrett-1-28-elongated-smartheight-toilet-combination): Barrett 1.28 GPF ADA-compliant elongated toilet with SmartHeight technology
- [Summit Edge 1.6 EL SMHT](https://www.mansfieldplumbing.com/product/summit-edge-1-6-el-smht): Summit Edge 1.6 GPF elongated SmartHeight toilet with rimless flush
- [Alto® 1.6 Round Toilet Combination](https://www.mansfieldplumbing.com/product/alto-1-6-round-toilet-combination): Alto 1.6 GPF round toilet with SmartFlush and SmartFasten technology
- [New Summit Pro](https://www.mansfieldplumbing.com/new-summit-pro-tank): Summit Pro toilet tank with Fluidmaster components and SmartFasten tech
